newsitem.title: FINLAND: TURKISTUOTTAJAT SAYS AUCTION PRICES UP.
newsitem.headline: TURKISTUOTTAJAT SAYS AUCTION PRICES UP.

text.p: Finnish fur auction house Turkistuottajat Oy said on Friday that a four-day auction that ended earlier in the day had strenthened fur prices, and that altogether 414 million markka worth of furs was sold.
"Turkistuottajat Oy's auction that ended on Friday strengthened the price level of both main articles of the fur trade, mink and fox," Turkistuottajat said in a statement.
The average price paid for Finnish fox furs was 435 markka per pelt, and almost 100 percent of the pelts were sold, it said.

"The price level for blue fox -- which is the main article in the Finnish fur business -- rose five to 10 percent compared to the February auction, depending on the size of the purchase," a spokeswoman said by telephone.
